Market Room Convenience

Discover a new level of convenience in Grand Central's Market Room, where you will find all your needs in the convenient one-stop-shop.
Easily located on Level 1, the Market Room provides a one-stop-shop for produce, groceries, butcher, baker and tea-maker. With over 2,000 car parks to choose from and 3 street access (choose Victoria, Little or Duggan Streets) there is plenty of opportunity to rush in, linger over coffee or browse through to dinner time in this convenient corner of Grand Central.

Rushing?

Errands to run? Kids to pick up? Dinner need prepping? Grand Central’s Market Room has you covered.

Head straight in from the 3pm school pick up and duck into the easy undercover parking before skootching through Woolworths for tomorrow’s lunch supplies. While you’re there, swing past and grab a bakery treat at Theo’s Bakery to add to the lunches. Don't forget to grab the dry-cleaning at Knights or the essentials at TerryWhite Chemmart so the whole family is sorted.

Grab afternoon tea at Sushi Party, healthy supplies from Central Health Foods or some supplements from Elite Supps to get you through your next workout. While the kids munch nearby at Tea Haus, use the time to stock up on fresh fruit and vege at Toowoomba Fresh and seek out in-house smoked specialties, handmade sausages or a variety of locally-sourced meats from Andrews Toowoomba.

For a quick dinner option (not to mention all your fresh seafood needs) head into Central Seafood Market for a cod n chips to take home. BWS will finish the quick whip-around for your evening needs.

 

Browsing?

Take a more leisurely approach on the weekends and find something fun to try at Hanaro Mart – you’ll be surprised by the range of international flavours. The Tea Centre is a sensory delight and you will bag some great flavours (tea pun!) and quality teaware. Need your phone fixed or protective screen put on your child's device? Stop in at Mobile Experts and they'll fix your device while you shop!

But first, coffee? The Coffee Club are serving up their signature house blend for all you coffee aficionados. Then head to Brooklyn Donuts & Coffee & Co for something a bit sweet, like their famous New York Cheesecake donut. 

 

Need to refresh or relax?

Visit Massage Philosophy for any occasion – Sunday morning relaxation treat, Friday afternoon wind-down or a well-earned gift for that hard-worker in your life. Or get a fresh cut at 2 Brothers Barbers before a special occasion.
